ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High intensity distribution; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels covering the central surface against 15% low-intensity black pixels concentrated along the periphery and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. High-contrast black banding is mapped along the lower leading edges and the irregular trailing edge. A distinct dark vertical streak is mapped at the 12 o'clock position relative to the median notch apex.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:3 within the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-amplitude serrations. The left lobe exhibits three primary high-depth jagged indentations. The right lobe displays a rhythmic, lower-amplitude sawtooth pattern with approximately 12 distinct peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep trajectory for both lobes, heavily disrupted by negative-space geometric anomalies (notches) along the trailing perimeter.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel-blobs (barnacles) are localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-aligned linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe contains 4-5 horizontal rake marks (some with reddish hue). Right lobe contains intersecting diagonal scratches of varying thickness.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss along the entire trailing edge contour. Visible parasitic or barnacle colonization at the terminal ends of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible reddish-pink pigmentation within several linear rake marks, providing high chromatic contrast against the white ventral background.
